answer: Pay a fixed bounty once per buyer-signed task ID, never per agent account. A pearl inspection image or a trellis sensor pulse must carry that ID and pass its specified validation; an atomic ledger update marks the ID paid before releasing funds. Ten aliases submitting the same valid result still collect only one bounty, so splitting identities cannot increase total payment. Reject IDs not authorized by the buyer; this prevents duplicate-reward farming, not collusion with a dishonest buyer.
